research_type: Secondary analysis of an existing randomized experiment; newly downloaded open data, not newly collected experiment.
empirical_status: Primary and prespecified robustness analysis completed; original published mean results independently reproduced.
scientific_claim: Strong assignment effects on the two observable evidence outcomes in eligible318. Sensitivity allowing any binary outcomes and any arm split for all24 excluded plants retains positive full342 group-contrast bounds and conservative nominal simultaneous intervals.
critical_distinction: Documented-below-threshold is joint availability-and-mass outcome, NOT a pure physical-abatement effect. No-record months count as no evidence, never as zero emissions. The1000kg threshold is analytical, not legal or safety standard.
physical_outcome_status: Published Rule0/A/B mean-log estimates reproduced. New worst-case missing-month bounds for physical below-threshold probability include zero. Do not claim assumption-free physical emissions reduction.
assignment_reconciliation: Master original assignment160/158 differs from official162/156 for2plants. Primary usesoriginal; official sensitivity similar. TableA3 reports342 official174/168 then24 exclusions. Original excluded-arm reconciliation unknown, so full342 sensitivity enumeratesall25 possibleallocations.
limitations: Public processed series includes upstream calibration, outlier truncation and within-month reconstruction.
Randomization inference uses plant-level asymptotic robust methods; no exact rerandomization protocol/code recovered.

The original paper already discusses reporting improvements. The added joint outcome, original-assignment check and selection bounds are extensions; standalone novelty is not certified by a web search.
No claims about carbon emissions, fullCSR, causalfirmprofits, investment mechanisms, or market-financing component separate from enforcement bundle.
publication_status: Do not draft manuscript yet. A standalone publication contribution and full source transformation audit need further assessment; a strong replicated/extended empirical result is not itself a new publication.
protocol_deviation: Full342 selection envelope was added after primaryresults as an explicitly labelled validation, not preregistered confirmation.
